## Core Services
- [Bathtub Refinishing & Reglazing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#bathtub-refinishing-orlando): Restore fiberglass, steel, porcelain, cast iron, clawfoot, and acrylic tubs to brand-new factory gloss in 2–4 hours. Includes chip, crack, hole, and rust repair plus optional non-skid bottom treatment.
- [Shower Refinishing & Resurfacing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#shower-refinishing-orlando): Revitalize stained, chipped, and hard-to-clean fiberglass, acrylic, and tiled shower stalls and pans without demolition.
- [Tile & Grout Refinishing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#tile-refinishing-orlando): Re-glaze ceramic and porcelain bathroom wall/floor tile and permanently seal grout lines without tearing out walls.
- [Countertop Refinishing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#countertop-refinishing-orlando): Transform kitchen and bathroom vanity countertops (Formica, laminate, cultured marble, tile) with durable Multi-Stone finishes.
- [Cabinet Refinishing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#cabinet-refinishing-orlando): Refresh worn bathroom vanities and kitchen cabinetry at a fraction of replacement cost.
- [Sink Refinishing & Porcelain Repair](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#sink-refinishing-orlando): Restore porcelain, fiberglass, and cultured marble bathroom and kitchen sinks; repair chips, cracks, holes, and rust.
- [Residential Refinishing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#residential-refinishing-orlando): Same-day bathroom and kitchen surface restoration for single-family homes, condos, townhomes, and vacation rentals.
- [Commercial Refinishing](https://www.bathprofessional.com/#commercial-refinishing-orlando): High-volume bathtub, shower, tile, and countertop refinishing for hotels, resorts, apartment complexes, senior living facilities, and property managers.
